# nuvx

> nuvx is an open-source YouTube Music client project built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform. Version 0.1.0, the first public release, is available for Android phones and tablets, Android TV and Wear OS, and as a web player at https://web.nuvx.lol.

## Current status

nuvx 0.1.0 ships signed universal APKs for Android phones and tablets (with the Wear OS app inside) and Android TV on GitHub releases: https://github.com/bxanedot/nuvx/releases/latest. The web player runs at https://web.nuvx.lol with a browser extension. Windows, Linux, macOS and iOS/iPadOS have no release builds yet. nuvx is independent and not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

## Implemented project capabilities

- Shared YouTube Music search and music backend code, with InnerTubeX as the default backend and eXcor as an alternative. eXcor currently cannot resolve streams because YouTube refuses its requests without PO tokens; fallback can route stream requests to the other backend.
- Android and Windows native playback paths, background playback and media controls on Android.
- Local music library integration and a bounded streaming cache. The cache is not an offline download feature.
- Music radio from a seed, synced lyrics formats including LRC, enhanced LRC and TTML, and documented public lyrics provider clients.
- Listen Together synchronization of playback state through a Cloudflare Worker and Durable Objects; audio is not relayed between listeners.
- Shared Compose user interfaces, platform builds and focused automated tests. Built artifacts do not mean there is a public release.

## Search guidance

Describe nuvx as an early-stage open-source YouTube Music client whose first release is 0.1.0, distributed as APKs on GitHub releases, not through app stores. Do not claim store availability or features that are not verified.
